title: Federal Government Orders Fresh Troops to Baidoa to Push Back Laftagareen Forces
detail: President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud instructed the Somali National Army on September 9, 2026 to reinforce federal troops already stationed in and around Baidoa and prepare an operation to drive opposition fighters loyal to former Southwest State president Laftagareen away from positions used to stage repeated attacks on the city. The order followed a phone call between Mohamud and Southwest State's current leader, Adan Mohamed Nur (Adan Madobe), and comes after opposition forces attacked Baidoa multiple times over the preceding three weeks, including the September 3 clash that wounded 71 and killed one civilian. As of September 9, the operation had not yet begun; the report did not disclose additional casualty figures.

media.caption: Somalia's federal government orders reinforcements to Baidoa against Laftagareen-aligned forces, Sep 9, 2026

title: Kenya Hosts Regional Workshop in Mombasa to Finalize Combined Anti-Piracy Task Force Framework
detail: Kenya hosted a Djibouti Code of Conduct (DCoC) Regional Workshop on Operational Cooperation and Coordination at Sea in Mombasa from September 7-9, 2026, working to finalize the operational framework for a proposed Combined DCoC Task Force to counter the 2026 piracy surge in the Western Indian Ocean and Gulf of Aden. The workshop, involving Working Group 3, reviewed the task force's proposed geographical scope, operational requirements, composition, and relationship to existing mechanisms like Combined Task Force 151 and EU NAVFOR's Operation Atalanta, ahead of recommendations going to the DCoC Steering Committee and the 9th DCoC/Jeddah Amendment High-Level Meeting. Nineteen signatory states — including Somalia — backed the task force proposal on August 13, 2026, after an extraordinary Steering Committee meeting on July 29; the force remains non-operational pending completion of this planning stage.

media.caption: DCoC signatory states, including Somalia, work toward a Combined Task Force framework at a Mombasa workshop, Sep 7-9, 2026
